About Our Shop
    Hi, I'm Hank Pemberton and I've been renting tools and equipment to folks in the Sandusky area since 1987. My shop is located at 4427 Industrial Way right off of Route 4, two blocks south of the old Ford plant. We're a family business — my son Marcus runs the counter most days and my nephew Dale handles the trailer and equipment delivery (he also made this here website, way back when).

    We rent over 200 different tools and pieces of equipment — everything from a $12-a-day drill to a $480-a-week stump grinder. If you're putting in a patio, tearing up old carpet, taking down a tree, throwing a wedding reception in your backyard, or doing about anything else around the house or job site, chances are good we've got what you need.

    Give us a call! We answer the phone. You can also stop in any time during business hours and we'll be glad to walk you through what you need. We do not rent online — never have, probably never will. Just call 419-555-2847 or come on by.
